cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook calls Shishkin a very stout opponent for 21-year-old Canadian prospect Wilkens Mathieu and argues that this is an unusually difficult developmental assignment. Shishkin has already faced the division's elite, although his loss to Osleys Iglesias is a material contrary signal. Paddy Power directly lists Shishkin at 7/1 (+700), Mathieu 1/10 (-1000) and the draw 20/1 (+2000); normalizing all three outcomes prices Shishkin near +765 fair. BetUS also references +700 but with a shorter -1250 favorite, while broader aggregator references are generally +600 to +650. The thesis is credible, but the available price does not yet create enough cushion.
